archived: Radius-1 disk data (disks of radius 1, N = 0), archived 2026-10-27 when disk pieces became diameter 1. Equivalent to diameter-1 disks at K = +-4 (K x 4, lengths x 1/2). Kept for reference, not served.

conventions.space: plane of constant curvature K: K < 0 hyperbolic, K = 0 Euclidean, K > 0 sphere of radius 1/sqrt(K)
conventions.units: geodesic lengths at curvature K; polygon pieces have side 1, disk pieces (N = 0) radius 1
conventions.pose: (x, y, theta): piece = T(exp_O(x, y)) R(theta) (standard piece); exp_O(x, y) is the point at distance sqrt(x^2+y^2) from the container centre O in direction (x, y); T the transvection along the geodesic from O; R(theta) the rotation about O; standard piece centred at O with a vertex straight up; at K = 0 this is PolyPack's Euclidean pose
conventions.container: centred at O, phi = 0 (horizontal bottom edge): regular M-gon of geodesic side s (walls at apothem h with tn_K(s/2) = sn_K(h) tan(pi/M)), or disk of radius r (M = 0); for K > 0 the container lies in the open hemisphere around O
conventions.score: s (M >= 3) or r (M = 0); smaller is better
conventions.score_float: touching limit found by the search (float64 polish)
conventions.score_cert: size at which the stored configuration `config` is proven valid with strictly positive clearance
conventions.display: score_cert rounded to the nearest at 6 decimals (ties to even, from its exact binary64 value)
